SKILL.md: description: Use when accounts payable books what a supplier billed and pays it — 登记进项发票 against a PO with 三单匹配, file the 付款申请, 核销 payments against bills, settle approved expense claims, record a supplier refund arriving ("戴尔退款到了"). Not the customer side (oryh-receivables) or placing a PO (oryh-purchase-order).
